warnings.message: Regional DEM route only; operational rover feasibility and fine-scale hazards remain unknown.
Stops snapped to grid centers; maximum offset 1747 m. Inspect stops for requested and snapped coordinates.

interpretation.text: Characterize terrain along user-selected regional transects; no automated survey completeness is inferred.

assumptions: 8-neighbor A* within the region grid; missing cells and slopes above the requested limit are blocked.
Inputs snap to containing DEM cell centers. No interpolated fine-scale route or connector is invented.
Energy = (mass*g*Crr*horizontal distance + mass*g*positive elevation gain)/efficiency/3600 + hotel W*drive hours.
Example rover parameters are assumptions, not a calibrated vehicle. No descent regeneration, solar recharge or stop-operation energy.
Slope risk is a heuristic slope/limit ratio, not probability or overall mission risk.
All ordered stops are attempted; path optimization never reorders or assigns scientific value to targets.
limitations: Regional orbital topography cannot resolve rover-scale rocks, wheel traction, cliffs or safe passages.
MOLA bins without laser shots were interpolated by the data producer; no shot-count layer is installed.
No illumination, thermal, communications, regolith-bearing, radiation or sampling model is applied.
Catalog region coordinates are starting references, not verified rover deployment or sampling locations.
